rule: Implementation objectives are not complete until material change is proven.
why: TOD must graduate from orchestration supervision toward independent execution. Wrapper-only success, status-only updates, and helper-path-only validation do not prove implementation.
applies_to: remediation tools that claim product behavior is fixed
reject_completion_when: only a wrapper re-described stale work
no relevant source file changed and no no-change repair justification exists
validation is py_compile-only for behavior objectives
helper/remediation path passed but live operator-facing path was not verified
diff exists but does not touch files relevant to requested behavior
allowed_no_change_completion: objective was investigation-only and explicitly not implementation
existing capability already satisfies objective and live-path proof is attached
canonical solution already exists and source evidence is fresh
operator_summary: TOD must show the patch, the relevant changed file, the behavior validation, and live-path/regression evidence before claiming implementation complete.
